messages: maya (Design): Uploaded v2 of network step mocks. Main changes: compact status chips, inline troubleshooting link, and a collapsed "Why this matters" aside. Screenshot attached. Feedback? raj (PM): Looks cleaner. A couple asks: 1) ensure chip labels are clear to non-network people; 2) add an affordance to copy debug commands with one click. tony (Eng): For the chips I'd use 'Online / Degraded / Offline' rather than technical terms. We can add a small copy button next to each sample command: [Copy] ssh user@host -p 22 lex (DevEx): Agree on copy button. Also propose a short collapsible FAQ under the probes: "What these checks mean" with 2-3 bullets, instead of dumping a big panel. Keeps initial UI lightweight. maya (Design): Happy to swap labels. Also thinking about iconography: use distinct shapes for statuses (circle / triangle / stop) so color + shape + text equals triple redundancy. Thoughts? a11y-bot: Automated note: shapes help, but ensure icons have non-visual text equivalents and the shapes are distinguishable at 16px. Also flag: current light orange fails AA contrast for normal text. tony (Eng): We'll pick a darker orange. For screen-reader announcements, I'm going to add role="status" and announce the specific probe name plus result. Example: SSH port probe: Online lex (DevEx): Small keyboard flow: make the copy buttons reachable via Tab and expose aria-labels like "Copy SSH debug command". Also trap focus out of the aside when it's open? Maybe not trap if it's a slide-in; just ensure focus lands in the aside first. maya (Design): Good point. I'll annotate the mock with focus order arrows and include the copy button states (copied/failed). raj (PM): Microcopy suggestion for the aside trigger: instead of "Why this matters" try "How this affects your private deployment" — more explicit. Keep the inline FAQ headline as "If this check fails". maya (Design): Will update. Also adding tiny help text under each probe: one sentence explaining impact and a terse remediation hint. Example: "SSH: required for agent install. If blocked, open port 22 to the control plane IPs." tony (Eng): For remediation steps let's include both cloud vendor notes (AWS SG / GCP firewall) and a one-liner command for network admins. Keep them as preformatted text blocks with copy buttons. a11y-bot: Quick check: preformatted text needs sufficient line-height and font size for readability at small widths. Also ensure copy buttons have visible focus rings. lex (DevEx): I'll draft an acceptance checklist we can use during QA: - status chips include text + shape + color - color contrast meets 4.5:1 for labels - aria-live announces probe name + state - copy buttons keyboard-accessible and have aria-labels - aside open state places focus on first heading and allows Esc to close - small-screen layout stacks chips above descriptions raj (PM): Solid. Let's aim to land the darker color and copy button in the next sprint; aside can be follow-up if timeline is tight. maya (Design): Thanks everyone. I'll push updated frames with annotations and link the PR. Ping me for a quick review when it's up. :rocket:
